# agents.ApprovalRequest

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Payload of an approval request (kind agent-command) that holds an agent mutation until a second member approves it.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `agents.ApprovalRequest` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.approval.read` |
